title: CWP/178/2025 of DINESH GARG Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND ORS
text:
Seema IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH Date of Decision: 27.01.2025 DINESH GARG hese PETITIONER VERSUS STATE OF HARYANA AND OTHERS .... RESPONDENTS CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE TRIBHUVAN DAHTYA Present: Mr. Ankur Sidhar, Advocate for the petitioner. TRIBHUVAN DAHIYA, J. (ORAL) The petition has been filed inter alia seeking a writ of mandamus directing the respondent-Commission to consider the petitioner’s candidature for the post of TGT English in response to advertisement 02/2023.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner contends that the petitioner has secured more marks than the cut-off marks under General/Unreserved category, and the representation dated 08.11.2024, Annexure P-11, submitted by him in this regard in response to announcement of the same date, Annexure P-10, is still pending with the respondent/Commission for decision.

3. Notice of motion.

4. Ms. Tanushree Gupta, DAG, Haryana, accepts notice on behalf of the respondents/State and, on instructions, contends that final decision on the petitioner’s representation will be taken by Secretary of the Commission and it will be conveyed to him within a period of four weeks.

5. In view of the statement made, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw the petition with liberty to the petitioner to challenge the order, in case the grievance is not redressed.

6. Permitted to do so.

7. Petition is dismissed as withdrawn, with liberty prayed for. (TRIBHUVAN DAHTYA) 27.01.2025 JUDGE Seema Seema
